wire.headline: Energy firm slashes jobs and closes plants amid rising costs
sentences: Revenue grew by 7% to 4.26bn GBP in the quarter to 30 September.
Pre-tax profit dropped by 12% to 310m GBP.
The company will cut 850 jobs, which represents about 6% of its workforce.
Two gas plants will close by March 2027, with locations in Wales and Kent.
CEO Marian Holt stated that cost pressure has been sharper than expected.
Ofgem has opened an investigation into the company's billing system.
The dividend has been held steady at 12.4p a share.
Shares fell by 4.2% in morning trading.
